AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted administrator record granting full Drive host and user-permission control.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

email.description: Verified Google email address of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was created.

UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Google-authenticated user account whose view and upload permissions are controlled by Admin.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

email.description: Verified Google email address of the user.

role.description: Account role. Regular users are locked to 'user' on registration.

canView.description: Whether the user is authorized by Admin to view/play media.

canUpload.description: Whether the user is authorized by Admin to upload media.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account first registered.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last profile or permission update.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profiles and Admin-assigned view/upload permissions.
